name: Meditrust Reviews
author: meditrust

sections.description:
Meditrust Reviews connects your WooCommerce store to Meditrust, a review and customer satisfaction platform.

When an order reaches the status you choose (for example “Completed”), Meditrust sends your customer a short satisfaction survey. Happy customers are invited to leave a Google review. Unhappy customers can tell you privately what went wrong, so you can fix it.

You can also show your best Google reviews on any page of your site with a small code snippet that the plugin builds for you, with a live preview.

Features

  • Connect your store to your Meditrust account with your private key.
  • Pick the WooCommerce order status that sends the survey (or turn surveys off).
  • Preview your survey right in your WordPress admin.
  • Build a Google reviews widget: number of reviews, language, live preview, one-click copy.
  • Works with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Available in English and French.
  • Clean uninstall: all plugin options are removed when you delete the plugin.

Requirements

  • A Meditrust account (free sign-up on meditrust.io).
  • WooCommerce, to send surveys after orders. Without WooCommerce, you can still use the Google reviews widget.

External services

This plugin connects to the Meditrust service (meditrust.io), run by Meditrust. It is needed to check your key, send surveys and show your reviews. Nothing is sent before you enter your private key.

  • Key check – https://meditrust.io/app/api/check_token.php. When you save your private key in the plugin settings, the key is sent to check that it is valid.
  • Order capture – https://meditrust.io/app/api/woocommerce/capture.php. Each time an order reaches the status you chose, the plugin sends your private key and the customer’s name, email address, phone number, customer ID, city, postcode, country, site language, the optional “billing_sex” order field and the order date. Meditrust uses this data to send the satisfaction survey. If you choose “Never (surveys off)”, nothing is sent.
  • Survey preview – https://meditrust.io/app/review.php. On the plugin settings page, your survey is shown in a frame loaded from Meditrust with your account ID and private key.
  • Reviews widget – https://meditrust.io/app/reviews_widget.js. The settings page loads this script to preview the widget. If you paste the widget code on your site, your visitors’ browsers load this script from Meditrust, with your key, the number of reviews and the language.

Meditrust terms of service and privacy policy.

The plugin also suggests a paragraph for your site’s privacy policy (Settings > Privacy).
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Meditrust Reviews”, then install and activate it.
  2. Open the new Meditrust menu.
  3. Paste your Meditrust private key (Meditrust > Account settings) and click Save.
  4. Choose the WooCommerce order status that sends the survey.
  5. Optional: open the “How to display your Google review on your website” tab, copy the code and paste it in a Custom HTML block.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Meditrust private key?

Log in to your Meditrust account, open “Account settings” and copy your private key.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

Yes, for the Google reviews widget. To send surveys after each order, WooCommerce must be active.

When is the survey sent?

When an order changes to the status you chose in the settings. Pick “Completed” to ask for feedback once the order is delivered.

How do I stop sending surveys?

Choose “Never (surveys off)” in the settings and save. No more order data is sent.

Which customer data is sent to Meditrust?

See the “External services” section above. Only data from the order is sent, and only when the order reaches the chosen status.

Is the plugin translated?

Yes, it is available in English and French.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release on WordPress.org.
  • Standard WordPress translations (English and French).
  • Security: permission check when saving the key, safer output, order status checked before saving.
  • New “Never (surveys off)” option.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS.
  • Privacy policy text and clean uninstall.
  • Settings link on the Plugins screen.
